title: About
text:
I’m a bilingual financial engineer based in Montreal, Quebec, currently at PSP Investments, one of Canada’s largest Crown corporation pension investment managers.
My work sits at the intersection of quantitative finance, credit risk, regulation, and derivatives management — building models and tools that help understand and manage complex financial exposures.
I work at the intersection of AI, financial engineering, and regulatory strategy in capital markets — helping organizations navigate complexity and build the quantitative tools and teams that define the next generation of finance
This site is where I share what I’m learning.
